snippet.title: The Great Wife's Guide - Exclusive Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The Great Wife’s Guide – a darkly satirical point-and-click puzzle game set within the picture-perfect suburbs of 1950s America. Players take on the role of Dolores, a devoted housewife pushed to her breaking point by a toxic marriage and the suffocating pressure of maintaining a flawless suburban life. Across short, focused puzzle levels, you will explore retro cartoon dollhouse environments, arrange carefully calculated acts of sabotage, and uncover the secrets concealed behind the walls of the perfect family home. The game's demo version will be released in 2027.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4881480/The_Great_Wifes_Guide/
